name: remote-job-monitor
description: Default tracked routing for local, passwordless SSH, and GitHub publish jobs with a token-free dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Default tracked route for SSH, remote jobs, and publishing.
interface.longDescription: Automatically prefers tracked RunBeacon jobs for non-interactive remote execution. Passwordless profiles reference ssh-agent, private-key paths, and Git Credential Manager without storing secrets. RunBeacon owns local and SSH command lifecycles plus Git commit, push, and Actions phases, waits inside the MCP server, and renders a live dashboard without repeated model turns.
defaultPrompt: Run this command on my SSH server through RunBeacon and continue when it finishes.
Open the live dashboard for my remote jobs.
Push my staged commit and monitor GitHub Actions in the dashboard.
